verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents AI Decisioning, which uses reinforcement learning to choose the best message, channel, and timing for each customer and then measures what worked. Its core unit is an agent that bundles an audience, goals, messages, scheduling rules, and guardrails, which matches autonomous per-customer decisions within guardrails the user sets. Missing for 10: concrete documentation of how lift is measured (e.g., holdout or control groups and reporting), detail on how the guardrails are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the autonomy and lift claims.
